content.title: AI agents pushing identity industry to new level: SailPoint CEO
content.description:
SailPoint's (SAIL) annual recurring revenue broke above $1 billion for the first time as the company reported third quarter earnings results for its fiscal 2026.

SailPoint founder and CEO Mark McClain speaks with Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi about how AI agents are both driving interest in the identity authentication landscape and are a cause for concern.
